story: Nifty 50 opened at 25,206, a gap-up of 0.25% from the previous close of 25,144.
The index dipped to a low of 25,172 (+0.11%) around 2:00 PM and touched a high of 25,338 (+0.77%) around 9:55 AM.
It settled at 25,291 (+0.58%), in the middle of the day's range, a session of two-way trade.
31 of the 50 Nifty stocks advanced and 18 declined; Bank Nifty outperformed (+0.89%).
Latest institutional data (12 Nov): FII/FPI net +7831 Cr, DII net -6331 Cr.
risks: Wall Street trades through tonight (from about 7:00 PM IST); the S&P 500 last closed at 7,561.67 (-0.40%), so US data and Fed commentary can swing the opening.
Brent crude is at US$92.84 (-3.13%); a sharp fall would help oil marketers and the rupee.
Currency and yields to track: USD/INR 93.923 (-0.12%), US 10-year yield 5.15% (+1.00%). A firmer dollar or higher US yields usually weigh on foreign flows.
GIFT Nifty keeps trading into the late evening, now 25,323.0 (+0.13% vs Nifty's close): the best live read on the next opening.
